narrative.overview: Ludora uses warm paper and white surfaces in light mode, and deep blue-green surfaces in dark mode. Rounded controls, a square-tile logo, and a restrained amber highlight connect the interface to board games. The patterned hero gives the home page a stronger visual treatment than the account and form screens.
dos: Do pair each semantic background with its corresponding foreground and use the shared focus ring in both themes.
Do use the matching artwork variant for the app logo and the favicon.
Do reuse shared button, field, card, and navigation variants for their existing roles.
